KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

2. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

7. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. fupi

8. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

9. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Kuzungumza:Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
